canonical_observation: Verified f1115cf PayeeRef already supports counterparty/employee/own_account and bare unidentified. Keep shared PayeeRef and AR/AP unchanged. Cash-only BankPayeeRef adds only optional nullable bank_label to unidentified; company kind prohibited. own_account.id resolves same-company FundingAccount.
patch_format: Per-file RFC6902 blueprint; target-relative $ref. Recursively expand sole-key $plan_ref from local fragments. No application authorized.

common: Owner/finance only; tenant from CommandContext. No PM/employee/PAT approval/post/match/correct; no payment/bank API or workflow engine.
PG lock company -> periods -> cash/draft/request/effective correction/match stable ids -> uniqueness. Recheck roles/versions/tenant/dates/dependencies. SQLite cannot prove concurrency.

Post integer cents 1..10^12; no float/bool. Draft update needs expected_version and editable state; new draft needs absent/null entity_id and version. Pending/approved snapshots immutable; server stamps maker.

dry_run defaults true before hashing: full checks, zero durable writes/refs/events. Same key/input returns original after auth; changed input conflicts. New keys cannot bypass provenance/effective uniqueness. Commit approval/facts/audit/outbox/ledger atomically.

created/updated returns one root ref+event; existing original receipt. Draft/match events have no accounting refs. Match changed_refs=new relation. Correction changed_refs=root, posting_event_refs=both accounting events; tenant-role filtering and event-id dedupe.
draft_and_record: Cash draft reuses existing record fields. BankPayeeRef=unchanged PayeeRef plus unidentified with optional nullable bank_label<=200; bare unidentified remains valid. No company kind or second company identity. own_account.id must resolve existing same-company FundingAccount under lock, never CP/Employee id.

core.document.decide cash_transaction handler: maker submits, distinct owner/finance reviews. Approval validates evidence, nonfuture date, open period, active same-company account, source uniqueness/payee, then internally calls cash.record on exact immutable approved snapshot in same transaction.

Keep all legacy record JSON shapes/optional fields. cash.record is internal posting: server-only approval/import context resolves approved snapshot/hash and reviewer. No client approval flag; source/dry_run=false alone insufficient. Authorized import needs equivalent independent approval. Unauthorized schema-valid direct post rejects.

Unique logical bank origin=company+frozen original bank-source namespace+original funding-account identity+external stable source key. Different original accounts may legitimately share the same bank sequence string. Freeze namespace/account at first approved import/record; corrected account/date/direction and new request keys never recompute or release this original identity. Approved draft id remains CashTransaction id; no second fact. Keep posted snapshot/source history immutable.

Unidentified bank cash is directly recordable through authorized record/import posting context without prior party matching, remains real cash and unmatched. Only formal clearance requires effective identified eligible party. own_account.id is same-company FundingAccount, eligible for internal transfer, never external AR/AP counterparty. Raw payee/bank_label immutable after posting.
party_match: identify appends CashPartyMatch for effective posted cash to existing same-company CP/Employee or own_account FundingAccount. No company kind, party/account auto-creation or second company identity. History relation id; at most one effective identification per logical bank origin under company lock. Known CP/Employee/own_account baseline authoritative; baseline change needs correction draft.

reverse appends action=reverse relation pointing to original identification; one reversal per original stable match id. Server resolves cash and tenant; original identify is retained, not edited. After reversal unknown baseline becomes unidentified again; later identify gets new stable relation id.

Both actions reject effective clearance/allocation/refund/return/payroll/classification/transfer/fee or other downstream dependence until dependency owner legally reverses it. No silent cascade. Raw original bank_label/payee untouched. Effective payee is one derived result: valid identification else approved baseline. Zero new cash/cost/revenue/ledger; never a refund.
Consumers cash classification, payroll, refund, transfer and clearance resolve this same effective identity under lock, not raw CashTransaction.payee; PM/employee outputs omit wage data.
correction: Correction draft selects original logical bank cash and complete corrected_fields. No external_source_key input: inherit original business key and provenance. Account, amount, direction, date and BankPayeeRef may change only with same-company accounts/parties and supporting evidence; gross positive, date not future. CashCorrectionRequest source kind is cash/cash_correction_request.

Register core.document.decide cash_correction_request handler; submit/approve/return/reject reuse existing independent-review rules. Maker cannot approve, stale approved version cannot post. Approval internally calls cash.transaction.correct/v1 with only approved request ref and server approval capability in same transaction; never expose as PAT/AI payment tool. This explicit command separates editable draft from immutable append, not a second approval.

Approval locks bank origin and rejects effective clearance/allocation/classification/payroll/transfer/fee/refund/return/match dependencies. Owner reversal first; no cascade. Freeze exact original version+effective predecessor at draft save, compare at approve; competing stale request cannot post.

Append CashCorrection and two AccountingEvents: reversal strictly negates EVERY currently effective original/replacement cash posting, retaining original book (cash_in or cash_out), scope/account, origin and source lineage; never switch reversal to opposite book. Then append replacement positive cash posting using corrected direction book and corrected funding account. Zero cost/revenue postings. Net cash changes only by correction delta, not a real refund; no cash.refunded event.

CashTransaction id, original row, external_source_key and original bank provenance remain immutable. No new logical bank origin or second CashTransaction. CashCorrection.corrected_fields is immutable effective snapshot projection; corrected transaction date is supported fact correction, original date remains visible. original_cash_ref always stable base, previous_correction_ref links exact effective predecessor; requests chain, never branch.

Locked old period stays locked: reversal/replacement post in selected OPEN adjustment period containing occurred_on<=today. occurred_on=correction recognition; corrected bank date stays evidence. Disclose delta in adjustment period, preserve locked snapshots and full fact lineage. Only correction overrides original-period-open rule.

Unique correction consumption per approved request and effective predecessor (organization+logical bank origin+previous correction id/null); no permanent single-correction ban. Multiple corrections allowed only serial approved chain. Old source key remains reserved permanently; changed funding account/date/direction cannot escape source uniqueness. Concurrent approvals lock origin and reject stale loser.

Core cash_transaction approval does not approve correction implicitly. New correction handler receives exact request kind only. One atomic root corrected event includes two accounting refs; accounting events/ledger are append-only, never balance update. Failure at any step rolls back approval and all reversals/replacements.

CashCorrectionRequest.previous_effective_correction_ref is a required server-derived frozen field, null on first correction. Draft save captures it and original_cash_ref.version atomically; approval compares both. It is not an editable client approval flag.
